scripts.//build: Explicit order: --workspaces walks packages/ alphabetically, which puts channel-feishu ahead of the channel-kit it compiles against.
scripts.build: npm run build -w dsh-channel -w dsh-session-manager -w dsh-channel-kit -w dsh-channel-telegram -w dsh-channel-wechat -w dsh-channel-feishu
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
